chunks.title: Account and payment
chunks.section: Account and payment > Payment methods
chunks.text:
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal.
Subscriptions can use any card, Apple Pay or PayPal. Bank transfer is available
for wholesale accounts only.

chunks.title: Account and payment
chunks.section: Account and payment > Updating a card
chunks.text:
Change the card from the account page under Payment. If a subscription payment
fails we retry twice over four days and email you each time before the box is
cancelled.

chunks.title: Account and payment
chunks.section: Account and payment > Changing your delivery address
chunks.text:
Update it from the account page before the roast day. Changes made after the box
is roasted cannot be applied, because the label is already printed.

chunks.title: Account and payment
chunks.section: Account and payment > Deleting your account and data
chunks.text:
Ask us to delete your account and we do it within 30 days, including order
history. Anything we are legally required to keep for tax purposes is retained
in accounting records only. We never sell customer data and never share it with
advertisers.

chunks.title: Account and payment
chunks.section: Account and payment > Trouble signing in
chunks.text:
Sign-in uses a one-time link sent by email rather than a password, so there is
nothing to reset. If the link does not arrive, check spam and confirm you are
using the address the order was placed with.

chunks.title: Coffee, grind and storage
chunks.section: Coffee, grind and storage > Choosing a grind
chunks.text:
We grind to order. Choose whole bean if you own a grinder, because coffee stales
several times faster once ground.

- Espresso: fine, like table salt
- Moka pot and Aeropress: medium-fine
- Pour over, V60 and Chemex: medium
- Cafetiere and French press: coarse, like raw sugar
- Cold brew: extra coarse

chunks.title: Coffee, grind and storage
chunks.section: Coffee, grind and storage > How long the coffee stays good
chunks.text:
Beans are at their best between 5 and 21 days after the roast date printed on
the bag. They are perfectly drinkable for about three months. Ground coffee
should be used within two weeks.

chunks.title: Coffee, grind and storage
chunks.section: Coffee, grind and storage > Storing it properly
chunks.text:
Keep the bag sealed, at room temperature, away from light. The valve on the bag
lets carbon dioxide out without letting oxygen in, so the original bag is better
than most containers. Do not refrigerate: coffee absorbs smells and condensation
ruins it. Freezing works only for unopened bags you will not touch for months.

chunks.title: Coffee, grind and storage
chunks.section: Coffee, grind and storage > Decaf
chunks.text:
Our decaf is Swiss Water processed, which uses no chemical solvents. It is
roasted on the same days as everything else and ships with the same guarantee.

chunks.title: Coffee, grind and storage
chunks.section: Coffee, grind and storage > Allergens
chunks.text:
Coffee is roasted in a facility that handles no nuts, dairy or gluten. Flavoured
coffees are not something we sell.

chunks.title: Returns and refunds
chunks.section: Returns and refunds > The freshness guarantee
chunks.text:
If you do not like the coffee, tell us within 30 days of delivery and we will
refund the order in full. You do not need to send the beans back, and you do not
need a reason. We would rather lose the sale than have you drink coffee you do
not enjoy.

chunks.title: Returns and refunds
chunks.section: Returns and refunds > How to start a refund
chunks.text:
Reply to your order confirmation email with the word "refund", or use the
contact form with your order number. Refunds are approved by a person, usually
within one working day, and land back on the original payment method in three to
five working days.

chunks.title: Returns and refunds
chunks.section: Returns and refunds > What is not covered
chunks.text:
Wholesale orders over 5kg are final sale, because they are roasted to order in
quantities we cannot resell. Gift cards are non-refundable but never expire.
Equipment such as grinders and brewers can be returned unused within 14 days.

chunks.title: Returns and refunds
chunks.section: Returns and refunds > Damaged or wrong items
chunks.text:
Send a photo of the bag and the packaging. We ship a replacement the same roast
day and do not ask for the original back.

chunks.title: Shipping and delivery
chunks.section: Shipping and delivery > When your order ships
chunks.text:
Roasting happens Monday, Wednesday and Friday morning. Orders placed before 6am
on a roast day ship the same afternoon; anything later goes out on the next
roast day. We do this so beans reach you within 48 hours of roasting rather than
sitting in a warehouse.

chunks.title: Shipping and delivery
chunks.section: Shipping and delivery > Delivery times
chunks.text:
| Destination | Carrier | Typical time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| United Kingdom | Royal Mail Tracked 24 | 1 to 2 working days |
| Ireland and EU | An Post / DPD | 3 to 5 working days |
| United States | DHL Express | 4 to 7 working days |
| Rest of world | DHL Express | 7 to 14 working days |

chunks.title: Shipping and delivery
chunks.section: Shipping and delivery > Shipping cost
chunks.text:
UK delivery is £3.95, and free on orders over £30. EU delivery is £8.50 flat.
United States delivery is £12 flat. Subscriptions always ship free, on every
destination, from the first box onward.

chunks.title: Shipping and delivery
chunks.section: Shipping and delivery > Tracking
chunks.text:
A tracking link is emailed when the parcel is collected, not when the order is
placed. If the tracking has not moved after two working days, contact us and we
will open a case with the carrier.

chunks.title: Shipping and delivery
chunks.section: Shipping and delivery > Customs and duties
chunks.text:
Orders outside the UK may attract import duty. We declare the true value on the
customs form and cannot mark parcels as gifts. Duty is paid by the recipient.

chunks.title: Subscriptions
chunks.section: Subscriptions > How the subscription works
chunks.text:
Choose a bag size and a frequency, and we roast and ship on that cadence. The
card is charged the morning of the roast day, not on signup, so you always know
what is coming before you pay for it.

chunks.title: Subscriptions
chunks.section: Subscriptions > Changing frequency
chunks.text:
Available frequencies are weekly, fortnightly, every three weeks, and monthly.
Change it from the account page under Subscriptions, or reply to any dispatch
email. The change applies to the next box, not the one already roasting.

chunks.title: Subscriptions
chunks.section: Subscriptions > Pausing and skipping
chunks.text:
Skip a single box from the account page up to 24 hours before the roast day.
Pausing stops all future boxes indefinitely and keeps your settings; there is no
minimum term and no cancellation fee. Resuming picks up the same schedule.

chunks.title: Subscriptions
chunks.section: Subscriptions > Cancelling
chunks.text:
Cancel from the account page under Subscriptions, or reply to any email from us
asking to cancel. It takes effect immediately unless a box has already been
roasted, in which case that final box ships and nothing further is charged.

chunks.title: Subscriptions
chunks.section: Subscriptions > Subscriber pricing
chunks.text:
Subscribers pay 15% less than the one-off price and always ship free. The
discount applies automatically and stacks with nothing else.

chunks.title: Wholesale and offices
chunks.section: Wholesale and offices > Who wholesale is for
chunks.text:
Cafes, restaurants, offices and anyone using more than 5kg a month. Pricing
starts at £16 per kilogram and drops at 20kg and 50kg per month.

chunks.title: Wholesale and offices
chunks.section: Wholesale and offices > Getting started
chunks.text:
Email wholesale with your location, the equipment you brew on, and roughly how
much coffee you go through in a week. We send samples of three roasts free of
charge, and a dialling-in visit is included for accounts within the M25.

chunks.title: Wholesale and offices
chunks.section: Wholesale and offices > Wholesale terms
chunks.text:
Accounts are invoiced monthly on 30-day terms after the first three orders,
which are paid up front. Wholesale orders are roasted to order and are not
refundable, though we will replace anything that arrives damaged or stale.

chunks.title: Wholesale and offices
chunks.section: Wholesale and offices > Office coffee
chunks.text:
Offices under 5kg a month are better served by a large subscription, which is
cheaper per bag and needs no account setup. We can invoice a company rather than
charging a card if that is easier for your finance team.
